title: The Inheritance of Those Waiting on the Lord
english: The feet of folly lead those who use it after death into Hades. Those who walk according to folly, using the feet of folly, are brought down into Hades. Just as there are feet of folly, so there are feet of pride.

Therefore, 'let not come to me the feet of pride' (Ps 26:4), meaning let there not be a walking of pride in my soul and in my mind. 'Nor let the hand of sinners shake me' (Ps 145:18). For hand is often said to mean practice, as if saying: 'Thorns grow in the hand of the drunkard,' meaning the shameful desires, the unrestrained pleasures.

13 There the workers of iniquity fell (Ps 1:4). Where the foot of pride and the hand of the sinner [are], 'they fell, those working iniquity.' It was not nature that led them into the fall, but the energy and work of iniquity. 13 They were driven out and are not able to stand. For since they themselves brought themselves down to the foot of pride, and are handed over to the hand of the sinner, which they chose to have, and this handing over is called their expulsion. And God, being a benefactor, drives them out so that they may not be able to stand in the evil. It is not, therefore, a nature or some external force casting him out, but his own work being iniquity and wickedness. He drives him out so that he may not remain, so that he may not hold a fixed stand in it.

And it is necessary to clarify the Scriptures more greatly. The truly God-wise man does this. However, if they were not clarified in this way, but more inferiorly, neither their magnitude nor that of the [God] who gave is shown. The Jews, indeed, taking them according to what is at hand and according to the human, are said 'not to perceive even what they say, nor concerning those things of which they are certain' (John 5:39). 9 That those committing adultery will be destroyed (Rom 1:28)—to be destroyed, but they are being destroyed in the way that they are evil, so that they may no longer be such. And it also signifies the punishment. And the punishment is again an impediment to wickedness. 9 But those who endure

They shall inherit the Lord a land. Those waiting on the Lord inherit the land already interpreted as being in highness, lying in the heaven. And this David said: 'I believe to see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living' (Psalm 27:13). He was a king. And to be a king is to have the good things of one's own land and to rule over it. But no one believes to receive what he already has, but believes to have received.

And this one says: 'I believe to see,' not 'I have seen' those good things, which God gives 'to those asking him,' when they pray sincerely concerning them. 'Those waiting' therefore 'on the Lord shall inherit the land' (Psalm 37:34). Endurance is a greatest contest of virtue: 'the tribulation works out endurance' (Romans 5:3). You see that after tribulation comes endurance. He therefore waits on the Lord as is necessary, having no endurance other than Him. And just as wisdom, righteousness, and sanctification become to some, so also endurance.

This David himself in another psalm says: 'And now what is my endurance? Is it not the Lord?' (Psalm 40:1). This endurance they always strive to have, those contending for virtue and piety. The hymnodist himself again says: 'Waiting, I waited on the Lord' (Psalm 40:1). Not simply 'I waited,' but 'waiting,' as in: 'to pursue the just thing justly.'

The servants of God have an inheritance. And listen to the paradox: to inherit is that of a child, not of servants. Therefore, the excess of the goodness of the thing inherited, as far as it reaches into their own state and nature, leads servants into an inheritance. And they used to say a parable for: 'By grace you are saved through faith, not of works' (Ephesians 2:8). And they used to say that it is impossible entirely to have faith without works: 'it is dead' indeed 'without works' (James 2:17). He says therefore: 'through faith, not of works.' And they used to say such an image: when a philanthropist is, instead of those whom some are working for and whom he is healing, he gives a reward...
